summary: This stylesheet styles a group of action buttons and links for a blog article, specifically a copy button and a raw markdown link. The wrapper uses flexbox to lay them out tightly together, and both elements respond to hover states by changing to a primary color. The comment explains why the spacing and styling choices were made to keep these elements visually grouped.

explanations.17: inline-flex makes the wrapper sit in the text flow (inline) but gives its children the layout power of flexbox.
explanations.19: gap: 6px creates space between child elements — this is smaller than normal row spacing to visually tie the items together.
explanations.26: var(--mk-ink-soft) is a CSS custom property, like a named color variable that can be changed in one place.
explanations.38: :not(:disabled) is a selector that means "only apply this style if the button is NOT disabled", so hover effects don't happen on disabled buttons.
explanations.43: .rawLink styles a plain text link with no border, unlike the button above it.
